name: Canned Food
description: Guidelines for traveling with canned food in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Canned food containing liquids or gels is subject to carry-on liquids rules (must be 3.4 oz or less). Because most cans exceed this, packing them in checked bags is highly recommended.
conditions: Cans may trigger additional screening or manual bag inspection because of their density.

faq.question: Is canned food allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Canned Food is restricted in carry-on luggage. Canned food containing liquids or gels is subject to carry-on liquids rules (must be 3.4 oz or less). Because most cans exceed this, packing them in checked bags is highly recommended.

faq.question: Can you pack canned food in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Canned Food is allowed in checked bags.
